title: Daily Check-In (Team)
summary: How teammates submit their daily check-in and see their attendance.

blocks.heading: Your daily check-in
paragraphs: Each working day, open Daily Check-In and submit before the deadline. Your status (On Time / Late) and attendance history are tracked here automatically.
Use the tabs to switch between Time Tracking, your Check-In, and Off Days.

blocks.caption: The Daily Check-In screen
blocks.alt: The team daily check-in screen with the Check-In tab, Check In button and status highlighted
